basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I'm currently exploring the world of cannabis investing while working part-time as a barista. I spend a lot of my free time gaming, especially on Call of Duty Mobile. I'm single and enjoy memes, especially those related to sports like NFL. I'm usually online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of cannabis investments, mostly self-taught through online articles and forums. My interest in sports memes comes from years of being an NFL fan, and I enjoy discussing strategies and updates with other fans.
